title: Healthy Habits for Kids! Wash Hands, Brush Teeth and More with Pip
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Pip the strawberry, and this is my buddy Kiko the broccoli!
Welcome to Fruity Friends! Today we're meeting five healthy habits.
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Healthy food and healthy habits help us grow big and strong.
Ready? Let's go to the kitchen!

lines: Here's a clue: we use soap and water, and we make bubbles! Can you guess?
This is Wash Hands! Can you say wash hands?
Wash your hands before you eat.
And after you use the potty, too!
Rub your hands together with me! Scrub, scrub, scrub!
Twenty seconds! Like singing a song.
Let's say it together: WASH HANDS!
One more time, nice and loud: WASH HANDS!
Here's a clue: we use a toothbrush to make our smile sparkle! Can you guess?
This is Brush Teeth! Can you say brush teeth?
Brush your teeth in the morning and at night.
Brush the top teeth and the bottom teeth.
Can you pretend to brush? Round and round!
Two minutes! Ask a grown-up to help.
Let's say it together: BRUSH TEETH!
One more time, nice and loud: BRUSH TEETH!
Here's a clue: it keeps us cool, and it's the best drink for our body! Can you guess?
This is Drink Water! Can you say drink water?
Drink water when you play and when you're thirsty.
Can you take a pretend sip? Glug, glug, glug!
When we're thirsty, and when we play!
Let's say it together: DRINK WATER!
One more time, nice and loud: DRINK WATER!
Water is the best drink for kids.
Here's a clue: we close our eyes, and we dream! Can you guess?
This is Bedtime! Can you say bedtime?
Your body rests, so you can play tomorrow!
Can you pretend to yawn and stretch? Yaaawn!
A cozy bed, and a quiet room!
One more time, nice and loud: BEDTIME!
A good sleep makes a happy morning.
Here's a clue: it's when we give some to a friend! Can you guess?
This is Sharing! Can you say sharing?
You can share toys, and you can share snacks!
Can you give a friend a big pretend high five?
What do we say when someone shares?
One more time, nice and loud: SHARING!

recap: Brush your teeth, morning and night.
outro: Which one was your favorite? Tell a grown-up, and try something new this week!
Bye, friends! See you next time on Fruity Friends!
